title: SmartMeterFM: Flow Matching for Smart Meter Data Generation, Imputation, and Super-Resolution Without Retraining
abstract: arXiv:2601.21706v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distribution system operators need realistic load and generation profiles when measurements are unavailable, incomplete, or too coarse for the intended analysis. Training separate models for synthetic data generation, imputation, and super-resolution can duplicate modeling effort as observation requirements change. This paper presents SmartMeterFM, a conditional flow matching model trained once on monthly smart meter profiles at 15 min resolution. Customer and calendar attributes condition the model during training, while numerical profile constraints, observed intervals, and coarse measurements are incorporated through projection-based guidance at inference. The same weights serve all tasks without task-specific retraining and preserve temporal patterns and extreme values while producing profiles consistent with the supplied observations. translated_title: SmartMeterFM：无需重新训练的智能电表数据生成、插补与超分辨率流匹配方法
translated_abstract: 当测量数据不可用、不完整或过于粗糙而无法满足预期分析需求时，配电网运营商需要真实的负荷与发电曲线。若针对合成数据生成、插补和超分辨率分别训练不同模型，会随着观测需求的变化而造成重复的建模工作。本文提出了SmartMeterFM，这是一种条件流匹配模型，仅需在15分钟分辨率的月度智能电表曲线数据上训练一次。训练过程中，模型以用户属性和日历属性作为条件；在推理阶段，则通过基于投影的引导方式引入数值曲线约束、已观测区间和粗糙测量值。同一组模型权重即可服务于所有任务，无需针对特定任务重新训练，并在与所提供观测数据保持一致的前提下，保留时间模式和极端值。基于荷兰用电与光伏发电曲线的大规模案例研究……
tldr: SmartMeterFM是一种仅需训练一次的条件流匹配模型，通过推理阶段的投影引导，无需针对任务重新训练即可同时完成智能电表数据的生成、插补和超分辨率，同时保留时间模式与极端值。
